name: Yamabuki Moe
source: She is the same age as Akane, and they went to the same primary school together. Moe is Aoi's younger sister, and works at her family's shrine as its maiden (miko) since she graduated high school. Despite playing together in their childhood, Moe is now cold and rude towards Akane. In fact, her coldness and rudeness isn't limited to Akane- the only person she seems to be amicable with is Aoi.
